title: Consecutive Value Changes
scenario: Identify IDs where the number changed to a value that had appeared consecutively at least twice before the change. Return 'id'.
hint: Use LAG() to compare current value to previous value and count streaks.
correctQuery: SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, num, LAG(num) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS prev, LAG(num, 2) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS prev2 FROM logs) t WHERE num != prev AND prev = prev2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (3, '2');
